description: Defines the RestorableFile class, an abstraction for managing temporary and backup files to enable safe file restoration and updates within the Android installd component.

classes.name: RestorableFile
classes.description: A class providing mechanisms to create, commit, restore, and remove temporary and backup files for safe file updates.

methods.name: RestorableFile
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an invalid instance with no file descriptor and empty path.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Default move assignment operator for RestorableFile.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the work (temporary) file, or -1 if none.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Returns the path of the regular file.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Closes the work file, deletes it, and resets internal state.

methods.name: ResetAndRemoveAllFiles
methods.description: Closes all files and removes work, backup, and regular files.

methods.name: CreateBackupFile
methods.description: Creates a backup of the existing regular file by renaming it; returns false if renaming fails.

methods.name: CommitWorkFile
methods.description: Renames the work file into the regular file; returns false if renaming fails.

methods.name: RestoreBackupFile
methods.description: Restores the regular file from backup; returns false if renaming fails.

methods.name: GetUniqueFile
methods.description: Returns a reference to the UniqueFile object associated with this RestorableFile.

methods.name: CreateWritableFile
methods.description: Creates a writable RestorableFile with a temporary file for writing.

methods.name: RemoveAllFiles
methods.description: Removes specified file and associated temporary files.
